key_concepts: Evolutionary change is heritable change in populations and species over time
Natural selection is the primary mechanism driving evolutionary change

Advantageous traits are passed to future generations, leading to gradual species change
Variation is differences in traits among individuals of the same species
Heredity is the transfer of traits from parents to offspring
Isolation occurs when organisms of the same species are separated by barriers or environme
Selection favors organisms with a particular genotype under certain conditions
